shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: «قالا، جميعا حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد» : the two branches meet at Yahya, and the names after him are the shared tail (rule 3)
«عبد الله بن، أبي سلمة» is one name with the comma as the text writes it
«حدثني أبي» (Sa'id's father) and «عن أبيه» (the Companion's father) are bare relations, not completed
